response.sql: SELECT o.observstation AS station, o.lunarstage AS moon_phase, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage_pct, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.observstation NOT IN (SELECT observstation FROM telescopes WHERE equipstatus = 'Maintenance') GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC LIMIT 10;
